youtube_description:
The View's guest is comedienne Joan Rivers. Joan talks about her appearance on Celebrity Apprentice, her charity work, her upcoming roast on Comedy Central, and her views on same-sex marriage. She also discusses her busy schedule, her love for Las Vegas, and her plans to do kegels instead of getting plastic surgery. Additionally, she shares her thoughts on Perez Hilton and her friendship with Ed McMahon.

Aired June 24, 2009.
